posts.description: A dev server and build on esbuild that does not use Vite: how to try it, what was measured, what does not work yet.

posts.title: Measuring Devora.js on two machines and four Node versions
posts.description: Eleven frameworks, two machines, Node 20 to 26: what we ran, where Devora.js is ahead and behind, and what we got wrong the first time.

posts.title: Devora.js 0.4.0: a security hardening release, and what to change before you upgrade
